notes: Faster startup and smaller JSON saves: remove unused historical leaderboard copies, stream atomic writes, preserve an original backup, and skip unchanged overlay data.
Fix packaged icon, gradient and player-color rendering so release builds match the development UI.
Add compact Twitch emote icon pickers with search and cursor insertion for your own channel emotes, available only in Twitch chat editors.
Automatically tag player usernames with @ in Twitch results, world records and cycle messages. Use the same Each placement template for every finishing position.
Include match type and map in default Twitch results, and support editable Twitch-only mission promotions labeled on stream with a live preview.
Add a seamless custom title bar with minimize, maximize/restore and close controls, matching the Missions app style.
Improve Lumia setup and connection notices, show Configure Lumia before a token is saved, and hide Remove when no token exists. Use branded Discord and Lumia sidebar status icons.
Keep RaceStats and RaceCycles controls independent and make Settings event rows more compact.
Show newest Live Log entries first with compact timestamps, scanned filenames, Race/BR winners and cycle completions.
Use the real rmrfkoHeart Twitch emote in the bundled offline MoS DropGate preview.
Update development and CI to Node.js 26.12.1 with the October 2026 Brotli security fix.
